dap.title: Account Deletion Request
dap.intro: This page explains how users of the Geonity application can request the permanent deletion of their account and all associated personal data, in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
dap.step1: Log in to your Geonity account at geonity.ibercivis.es or through the Geonity mobile app.
dap.step2: Click your avatar in the top bar to open the user menu, then select "Profile".
dap.step3: Scroll to the bottom of the profile page and click the "Delete account" button.
dap.step4: Confirm your decision in the dialog. Your account and data will be permanently and irreversibly deleted.
dap.altDesc: If you cannot access your account, send a deletion request from the email address associated with your account to:
dap.deletedItem1: Account credentials: email address, encrypted password, and authentication tokens.
dap.deletedItem2: Personal profile: name, biography, country, and profile photo.
dap.deletedItem3: Organisation memberships, roles, and pending invitations.
dap.deletedItem4: Observations attributed to your account, unless you chose to keep them anonymised.
dap.retainedItem1: Anonymised observations — if you selected "Keep my observations" at deletion time, your scientific contributions are preserved with all identifying information removed. They cannot be linked back to you.
dap.retainedItem2: Aggregated, non-identifiable statistics derived from platform activity.
dap.retentionDesc: Personal data is permanently removed from our systems within 30 days of the confirmed deletion request. Anonymised scientific observations are retained indefinitely as part of the public research record and cannot be traced back to any individual.
dap.contact: For any questions about your personal data, contact us at:
pp.title: Privacy Policy
pp.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Ibercivis Foundation ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects the personal data of users of the Geonity application and website (geonity.ibercivis.es). By registering, you explicitly accept this policy.
pp.s1body: When you use Geonity, we may collect the following personal data:
pp.s1item1: Account data: email address, first name, last name, and (optionally) a biography, country, and profile photo.
pp.s1item2: Authentication data: encrypted password or, if you sign in with Google, your Google account identifier.
pp.s1item3: Observation data: georeferenced field observations you submit, including location coordinates and any photos or form responses attached.
pp.s1item4: Usage data: information about how you interact with the platform (pages visited, actions performed).
pp.s1item5: Device data: browser type, operating system, and IP address, collected automatically for security and analytics purposes.
pp.s2title: 2. Legal basis and how we use your data
pp.s2body: We process your personal data on the following legal bases under GDPR: (a) your explicit consent, given at registration, for account creation and participation; (b) our legitimate interest for platform security and aggregated analytics. We use your data exclusively for the following purposes:
pp.s2item1: To create and manage your Geonity account and authenticate you.
pp.s2item2: To allow you to participate in citizen-science observation projects.
pp.s2item3: To send transactional communications (e.g. organisation invitations). We do not send marketing emails.
pp.s2item4: To improve the platform through aggregated, anonymised usage analytics.
pp.s3title: 3. Data sharing, third parties, and roles
pp.s3body: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We use Google OAuth as an optional authentication provider; if you choose to sign in with Google, their Privacy Policy also applies. Observation data you submit may be visible to other participants within the same project, according to the project's privacy settings. Regarding data roles: for platform user data (your account), Ibercivis Foundation acts as data controller. For observation data collected by project creators from their participants, Ibercivis acts as data processor and the project creator is the data controller — they are responsible for their own GDPR compliance towards participants.
pp.s4body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active. Upon account deletion, personal data is permanently removed within 30 days. Anonymised scientific observations you chose to keep are retained indefinitely as part of the public research record.
pp.s5body: If you are located in the European Economic Area, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
pp.s5item1: Right of access — to obtain a copy of your personal data.
pp.s5item2: Right to rectification — to correct inaccurate or incomplete data.
pp.s5item3: Right to erasure — to request deletion of your account and data (see our Account Deletion page).
pp.s5item4: Right to restriction and objection — to limit or object to certain processing.
pp.s5item5: Right to data portability — to receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
pp.s6body: Geonity is not directed at children under 14 years of age (the minimum age under Spanish law, consistent with GDPR). Registration by minors under 14 is not permitted. If you believe a minor under 14 has registered, please contact us immediately at ethics@ibercivis.es so we can delete their data.
pp.s7body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. All data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections.
pp.s8body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised. Continued use of Geonity after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
pp.contactBody: For any questions, requests, or concerns about your personal data or this Privacy Policy, contact us at:
aboutHeroSubtitle: Create projects, collect geolocated observations, and collaborate — on web and mobile, in your language.
aboutWhatBody: Geonity is a free citizen science platform for researchers, organizations, and communities. Design data-collection projects, gather real-world observations from any device, and collaborate in 7 languages.
aboutFeature1Body: Design your own project with fully customizable forms — text, numbers, photos, multiple choice. Set topics, geographic scope, and visibility rules.
aboutFeature2Body: Contribute from any browser. Mobile apps for Android and iOS are on their way.
aboutFeature3Body: Available in 7 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, and Dutch. Projects and forms support multilingual content.
aboutFeature4Body: Group projects under organizations, invite collaborators, and assign roles. Ideal for research institutions, universities, and NGOs.
aboutFeature5Body: Public or private projects, private data mode, and fuzzy location rounding to protect participant privacy. You decide who sees what.
aboutFeature6Body: No subscription, no hidden fees. Geonity is free for individuals, universities, and organizations alike.
aboutMobileBody: Use Geonity from any browser today. The Android app is available on Google Play. iOS coming soon.
aboutStep1Body: Define your project name, topic, geographic area, and data-collection form. Invite participants or make it open to everyone.
aboutStep2Body: Participants submit geolocated observations from the web or mobile app. Each entry is stamped with location, time, and your custom fields.
aboutStep3Body: Filter observations by contributor or date, and export your full dataset as CSV for deeper analysis.

tou.title: Terms of Use
tou.intro: These Terms of Use govern the creation and management of projects on the Geonity platform. By creating a project, you agree to comply with the following rules, designed to protect participant privacy and ensure responsible data collection in accordance with applicable regulations, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
tou.s1body: Projects may be created by any registered user acting on behalf of a research group, educational institution, non-profit organisation, or individual citizen-science initiative. Commercial data-collection for resale is not permitted.
tou.s2body: When collecting data from participants, project creators must:
tou.s2item1: Inform participants about what data is collected, why, and how it will be used — before they contribute.
tou.s2item2: Obtain freely given, specific, and informed consent from all participants prior to data collection.
tou.s2item3: Apply data minimisation — collect only what is strictly necessary for the scientific or educational purpose.
tou.s2item4: Never collect data from children under 14 (the minimum age for registration on Geonity). If your project targets younger audiences, participation must go through a responsible adult.
tou.s2item5: Never use participant data for commercial purposes, advertising, or sharing with third parties without explicit consent.
tou.s3body: Project creators based in or collecting data from individuals in the European Economic Area (EEA) must comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). This includes: identifying the legal basis for processing (typically consent or legitimate interest), honouring data subject rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability), and not transferring personal data outside the EEA without appropriate safeguards. As explained in our Privacy Policy, Ibercivis Foundation acts as data processor for participant data; the project creator is the data controller and bears full responsibility for GDPR compliance towards their participants.
tou.s4item1: Creating projects with deceptive, misleading, or undisclosed purposes.
tou.s4item2: Collecting sensitive personal data (health, biometric, religious, or political) without explicit, informed consent and a documented lawful basis.
tou.s4item3: Sharing or selling participant data to third parties without their knowledge and consent.
tou.s4item4: Using the platform to monitor, track, or profile individuals without their knowledge.
tou.s5body: Ibercivis Foundation reserves the right to suspend or delete projects that violate these terms without prior notice. Repeated violations may result in permanent account suspension. To report a project you believe violates these rules, contact ethics@ibercivis.es.
tou.contactBody: For questions about these Terms of Use or your data protection obligations as a project creator, contact us at:
